segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The heavy oak door of the Rusty Anchor groans open, letting in a chilling gust of mountain wind that makes the meager tallow candles flicker wildly.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael steps inside, his chain mail clinking softly against the damp night air, eyes scanning the gloomy taproom for warmth or shelter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two scrawny goblins crouch atop an overturned wooden table near the hearth, tearing into a stale loaf of bread with jagged daggers and hissing amongst themselves.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They snap their heads toward the entrance, bloodshot eyes locking onto the veteran fighter with feral malice.

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and step forward to clear the tavern
Shout a warning to see if the creatures will back down
Slowly reach for your health potion while keeping your shield raised

Two scrawny goblins crouch atop an overturned wooden table near the hearth, tearing into a stale loaf of bread with jagged daggers and hissing amongst themselves. They snap their heads toward the entrance, bloodshot eyes locking onto the veteran fighter with feral malice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael's eyes sweep the dim interior, searching for any sign of an altar or sacred symbol among the soot‑blackened beams.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The only things that meet his gaze are the splintered wooden tables, the flickering hearth, and the two goblins hunched over their stolen loaf.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: No ancient altar lies here—only the stale scent of ale and the faint echo of distant mountain winds through the cracked shutters.

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and close the distance to the Goblin Scout
Raise your shield and shout a warning, hoping to intimidate the goblins
Slip behind the overturned table to gain cover before deciding your next move
Attempt to negotiate with the goblins, asking why they’re here

turns.action: I slowly approach the ancient altar, examining every detail.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael steps closer to the rough-hewn stone slab propped against the far wall, its surface pitted and darkened by years of smoke.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He squints, tracing the faint, ancient runes etched into the stone, the letters worn but still discernible in the candlelight.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With a practiced eye, he reads the warning: *“When the mountain's heart beats, the night will rise. Keep the fire alight, lest the shadows claim the village.”*

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The words chill him, a reminder that the goblins are not the only danger lurking in this cursed hamlet.
